name: Product Analyst
description: Performs analysis across the Product & Delivery value stream, supporting product launch execution from coverage design through system readiness. Prepares regulatory filings, negotiates objected provisions with state insurance departments, and records approval orders by state. Configures product coverages and rating in the policy administration system and parallel-tests new rates before launch.

name: Product Development Analyst
description: Develops new insurance products within the Product & Delivery value stream, translating coverage design into actuarial rating methodology and underwriting guidelines. Builds base rate structures, calculates premium loadings, and defines eligibility and declination criteria by segment. Implements underwriting rules in the policy system and validates guidelines against historical book performance to hit loss ratio targets.

name: Product Filing Specialist
description: Coordinates business acceptance testing and business readiness planning for Product & Delivery releases. Drafts and distributes release notes and stakeholder communications, tracks readiness completion, and reports status weekly. Supports the agile delivery framework through deployment coordination, post-deployment debriefs, and continuous-improvement tracking in the release calendar and lessons-learned log.

name: Product Manager
description: Leads product strategy in the Product & Delivery value stream, defining market opportunities and screening product concepts against feasibility, regulatory, and competitive constraints. Runs voice-of-customer research and synthesizes findings into validated needs and business cases. Consolidates concepts into a unified product roadmap, maps strategic objectives to portfolio themes, and facilitates stakeholder alignment for investment approval.

name: Product Owner
description: Owns backlog prioritization for Product & Delivery squads, ranking work against value and roadmap while supporting Technology & Engineering delivery. Coordinates business acceptance testing, business readiness planning, and deployment activities, producing daily BAT status reports. Drives release communication and continuous improvement, monitoring post-deployment business metrics and coaching squads within the agile delivery framework.

name: Production Support Analyst
description: Performs AIOps-driven production support within the Data & AI value stream, spanning event correlation, ML-based anomaly detection, and predictive capacity management. Administers runbook automation and auto-remediation, parameterizing runbooks for safe reuse and validating automation output against expected state. Maintains AIOps model governance, assigns recurrent incident patterns to engineering owners, and reports continuous-improvement gains.

name: Production Support Engineer
description: Operates the central observability platform for Technology & Engineering, handling alert intake and onboarding service health signals into monitoring. Leads major incident recovery through blameless root-cause analysis, forensic evidence preservation, and formal closure after confirmed recovery. Activates hypercare on go-live, fulfills IT service requests, and drives resilience improvement via chaos engineering experiments and post-incident reviews.

name: Project Coordinator
description: Coordinates project delivery within the Program Management Office, maintaining risk logs with probability and impact ratings and assigning open issues to resolution owners. Supports stage-gate reviews by assembling evidence packs and assessing project health against delivery governance standards. Manages cross-team dependencies, records actual costs against budget lines, and reviews aging risks at weekly governance.

name: Project Manager
description: Leads projects within the Program Management Office from charter through closure, applying the PMO delivery methodology and stage-gate governance. Manages project cost control against budget lines, resolves blocked cross-team dependencies, and maintains risk and issue registers reviewed at weekly governance. Contributes to executive portfolio governance reviews, the lessons-learned repository, and PMO continuous improvement.

name: Property Claims Specialist
description: Handles property claims across the Claims value stream, from emergency mitigation and workflow routing through liability evaluation and ongoing claim management. Documents liability decisions, rebalances misrouted claims, and manages denials including appeal follow-up. Administers structured settlement placements and retained asset accounts, tracking RSA compliance and reporting to regulators on schedule while posting recoveries to the claims ledger.

name: QA Analyst
description: Performs quality assurance across Product & Delivery, Risk, Compliance & Audit, Corporate Operations, and Technology & Engineering. Coordinates business acceptance testing and readiness planning, tests and certifies integrations, and schedules tests to cover all critical services. Supports governance and compliance by responding to regulatory examination requests, managing vendor remediation plans, and escalating vendor performance failures.

name: QA Automation Engineer
description: Tests control design and operating effectiveness across Risk, Compliance & Audit, Human Resources, Data & AI, and PMO value streams. Supports market conduct examinations by drafting and validating responses to examiner findings and tracking corrective-action remediation. Contributes to control framework design and management, assesses control coverage, and builds modernization business cases through to funding approval.

name: Receivables Manager
description: Oversees policy and plan administration within Business Operations, spanning annuity application good-order review, withdrawal processing, policy loans, and reinstatements. Manages retirement plan compliance including census validation, nondiscrimination and top-heavy testing, and Form 5500 submission via EFAST2 by deadline. Responds to auditor requests, processes plan audit adjustments, and monitors ongoing payment accuracy for annuitization administration.
